heading: INT. OAKRIDGE LIBRARY - READING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. OAKRIDGE LIBRARY - READING ROOM - NIGHT
Three strangers sit at a long table, phones face-up between them.
The group chat on each screen is called "ORBIT-7."
It is 11:47 PM.
So you're "starfield_88"? You said you'd be taller.
units.name: JAMAL
paren: checking his phone, then the door

units.text: I said I was five-foot-two. You never listen.
units.name: LENA
paren: laughing nervously, pulling her sleeves over her hands

units.text: Every phone BUZZES at the same moment.
Jamal reads his aloud.
"We are glad you came."
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: The message is from no one.
The chat shows three members.
There should be four.
Who sent it?
units.name: LENA

units.text: We did.
units.name: THE ORBIT
paren: from all three phones at once, flat and kind

units.text: Jamal drops his phone.
Lena grabs his sleeve.
The third person, Okoye, who has said nothing all evening, stands slowly.
I told you both it would be real.
units.name: OKOYE

units.text: Nobody in this room has ever been so afraid, or so certain, of anything.
The lights in the reading room dim to blue, one by one.
The phones go dark except for one word on each screen.
It says "Home."
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Okoye, please. Say you didn't know.
units.name: LENA

units.text: I always knew.
units.name: OKOYE

units.text: Thank you for coming.
units.name: THE ORBIT
